title: Moon Dev's edge layer: does order flow, liquidation and funding data fix his MA pullback?
market: Crypto: 16 Binance USDT perps 5m + 15m. TSLA 2m + 5m RTH (Nasdaq lit tape + block prints).
data: /Volumes/Moon 26/tick_data/binance/futures_klines_1m/<SYM>/<SYM>_1m_*.parquet (2020-01 -> 2026-10, taker_buy_volume); /Volumes/Moon 26/tick_data/binance/funding/*_funding.csv (2024-01 -> 2026-08); moon-dev-trading-bots/data/moondev_api/liq_clean_{BTC,ETH,SOL,XRP}_5m.csv (2024-06 -> 2025-12; the liq_data_*_ohlcv files are banned in data_sources.md for fake prices); /Volumes/Moon 26/tick_data/derived/tsla/lit_rth_{hist,orig}.parquet + big_prints_{hist,orig}.parquet (2024-07-01 -> 2026-09-23)

headline.label: MA only vs MA + Moon Dev data, out of sample
headline.value: OOS after costs, avg R per trade. Crypto 15m (16 perps): MA only -0.419R -> MA + flow -0.274R. Crypto 5m: -0.772R -> -0.489R. TSLA 5m: -0.16R -> -0.081R. Data cuts the loss but nothing makes money.

stats.costs: crypto 0.05% taker + 0.02% slippage per side (0.14% round trip); TSLA 1 bp per side + $0.005/share per side. avg_R_zero_cost = same trades with no cost. Equity = compounding, 1% risk a trade (video gives no size). Stop = trigger bar other end, target 2R, max hold 48 bars (both sweeps).

claims.claim: The MAs are only one part of the plan, never trade just because price pulled back to the 20 SMA
claims.test: Same pullback trades, MA only vs MA + best 2 Moon Dev data filters (picked on IS), judged OOS 2024-07 -> 2026-10
claims.verdict: VERIFIED (MAs alone lose; the extra info helps) but the better version still loses after costs

claims.claim: Enter above a doji / bottoming tail bar at the MA, stop under its low
claims.test: Trigger bar close location (clv). Bottom third = no tail, top third = bottoming tail. Crypto 5m, zero cost
claims.result: no tail -0.384R vs bottoming tail 0.030R per trade (zero cost)
claims.verdict: VERIFIED as the strongest single filter, stronger than taker flow. Still too small to pay costs

claims.test: MA pullback on 16 Binance perps, 5m and 15m, 2020 -> 2026, before any cost
Slope floor sweep (20 SMA move over 5 bars in ATRs): 0.1 / 0.3 / 0.6. Crypto 5m, 2R, zero cost
claims.verdict: BUSTED here: a steeper slope floor did not help (package 2 owns the full test)

claims.claim: Moon Dev idea (not in the video): long liquidations flushing into a long pullback = fuel
claims.test: liq_clean BTC/ETH/SOL/XRP 2024-06 -> 2025-12, 60/40 split, same-side liqs in the last 3 bars
claims.result: crypto 15m OOS: MA only -0.538R vs filtered -0.386R (liq_fuel >= 0.134)
claims.verdict: NOT PROVEN (helps a bit, short sample, still loses)

claims.claim: Moon Dev idea: funding extreme against the trade
claims.result: crypto 5m OOS: MA only -1.277R vs filtered -1.335R (fund_crowd <= -0.3117)

takeaways: BUSTED: his MA pullback has no edge on crypto or TSLA even before fees (about -0.05R a trade on crypto).
Moon Dev's taker flow on the trigger bar is the best data filter: buyers in control on the trigger bar = fewer losers. It held out of sample on every market.
Half of that flow edge is just candle shape. His own words (enter above a bottoming tail, 0:25) are the strongest filter we found.
Costs are the killer. A 5m crypto stop is so tight that 0.14% round trip eats about 0.5R (median trade) to 0.7R (average) a trade. 15m: about 0.3R to 0.4R.
Liquidation fuel and funding: short samples, small or no help. Not worth trading on.
Best version (rules + flow + volume) still loses after costs: do not run it with real money.
